notes.title: 🔔Release notes - v2.2.13
notes.content:
[New]
■ Background
· Added slot machine games to Community Room – Crocodile Teeth, Pirate Roulette

[Changed]
■ Game
· One Card – Adjusted bankruptcy system, modified card submission delay
· Catch The Ghost – Modified forfeit system
· GoStop – Fixed bomb Pi calculation, adjusted holder size, and added dynamic holder props

■ Background
· Community Room slot machine item – Balloon handle model changed

■ System
· Modified forfeit system
 - Forfeit within 3 minutes: match will be invalidated
 - Forfeit after 3 minutes: player receives point deduction

[Fixed]
■ Game
· Fixed repeated grab issue in card games
· Rummy – Fixed number display issue in Runs
· Gin Rummy – Fixed UI alignment, skip & retry issues, and round result bug
· Yut Nori – Fixed movement issue and out-of-board judgment area
